claims.statement: A coding agent changing a concrete Python implementation symbol can recover otherwise missed syntactic consumers through a one-hop explicit package re-export and inspect the corresponding existing verification candidates, without treating those references as runtime binding or test coverage.

attributes.title: Package-interface source understanding

alignment.basis: Improve the actual software-engineering beneficiary outcome under ADR 0038.

ambition.basis: Extend bounded AST source inquiry and verification candidate composition.

horizon.basis: Actual package re-export and downstream consumers in current source.

realization.basis: Actual hosted run 46109120263 at exact candidate d0ddf702 compared old/new source relationships and verification plans on fixed actual BASE e9b710f6. For probe_python_imports the explicit initializer import at line 25, CLI reference at 979, and two substrate tests at 21 and 34 were recovered. For build_repository_semantic_map the initializer import at line 9, CLI reference at 1029 and two substrate tests at 65 and 83 were recovered. Both routes carried the exact initializer SHA-256, literal __all__ membership, consumer binding lines 13/7 and separate PACKAGE_REEXPORT_TEST_FUNCTION provenance in deduplicated pytest candidates. Prior direct source fields, authored context, target identity and old plan targets/evidence were preserved. No-route real committed_regular_file_status retained identical candidate list. Limit one disclosed one of two actual test candidates omitted; complete selected package scopes were not truncated at 80. Existing public verification-plan CLI matched composed result. No tests executed or coverage inferred. Six-path canonical rehearsal verified exact source bytes, two Python parses and valid three-claim/six-relation proposal.
